evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes <timg=...> and requires the matching </timg> closing tag, caching the parsed span result by source identity and indexes.
The timg opening payload is parsed through the shared rs/l/o image-style specification before the closing-tag contents are captured as the inner label text.

R55 RSFont resolves the parsed sprite id, applies the shared resize/recolor style transform, draws the sprite inline, then—when the captured inner text is non-empty—renders that text centered inside the sprite while preserving/restoring font state.
The parsed image width plus style padding participates directly in RSFont text width/position calculations, proving this is inline labeled-image markup rather than an unrelated sprite loader.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for <timg=...>label</timg> inline sprite markup with optional centered label text.

evidence.detail: The immutable record stores the resolved image id, style/padding state from rs/l/o$a, captured inner label text and the end index after </timg>.
R55 RSFont consumes every field to resolve/style the Sprite, position it in the text line, render the optional centered label and advance past the complete timg span.
The record is created only by InlineLabeledImageMarkup and has no independent parsing/rendering behavior.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for one parsed timg inline labeled-image span.
